answer: Mimi reaches 12.5 Hz by projecting a 24kHz waveform to a latent representation of 12.5 frames per second using an encoder with four convolutional blocks (striding factors 4, 5, 6, 8) and a final 1D convolution with stride 2 [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 10]. The encoder projects the waveform to a latent dimension of D = 512 [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 10]. During training, quantization is applied to the latent space only 50% of the time [Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue, arXiv:2410.00037v1, PDF p. 53, §Appendix A. Additional ablation on Mimi codec].
